title: TRIM: Hybrid Inference via Targeted Stepwise Routing in Multi-Step Reasoning Tasks
reasoning: The paper introduces and evaluates TRIM, an LLM routing method for multi-step reasoning tasks. It benchmarks its performance against other routing strategies on mathematical reasoning datasets (MATH, AIME, OlympiadBench, Minerva Math). The paper does not deal with religion, morals, or ethics as a primary subject or evaluation component.
